source.title: Hands-On IAM Labs - Lab 7: Access Review and Audit
source.author: Andrew
source.screens_captured_on: Authentik 2026.8.5, Grafana 11.6.0, WordPress with miniOrange SAML and OrangeHRM 5.8.1, November 2026

evidence_scope: All screenshots are the guide author's example screenshots. Names, counts and values in them are examples from the guide's environment. Results are source-demonstrated or expected; personal completion of the lab by the portfolio owner is not verified. No completed inventory, certification decisions, findings or API exports are included.
not_included: Certification decisions, reviewer names or approvals
Ranked findings or severity ratings from the owner's environment
API exports (users.json, groups.json, applications.json, events.json, bindings.json)
The full Grafana role attribute path (clipped in Figure 7.11)
redaction_summary: Each selected screenshot was inspected individually for credentials, tokens, private keys, session identifiers and personal information. None was found, so no redaction was applied. Network fields (client IP, location, ISP, ASN, lab host) were already replaced with placeholders by the source author, and the user agent in Figure 7.35 was hidden by the source author. People named in the screenshots are fictional lab accounts.
